{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Structured wool-blend blazer in charcoal gray (#3a3f45), tailored fit with a single-breasted closure and notched lapel.
High-waisted pleated midi skirt in deep burgundy wine (#6b2c31), knee-length cut with subtle side seams.
Silk blouse in soft cream (#fdfbf7), relaxed neckline with slight gathering at the shoulders.
Chunky knit cardigan in heather gray (#d4d0ce), oversized boxy silhouette with ribbed cuffs and hem.
Pointed-toe ankle boots in polished leather, medium heel height in taupe brown (#8a7f76).
Gold vermeil drop earrings with small geometric pendants (#ffd700).
Delicate pearl and gold chain necklace featuring a small pendant (#f7f5e6).

This ensemble balances the celebration's smart dress code with her requested triadic palette, using charcoal, burgundy, and cream to create visual harmony under artificial evening lighting. The structured outer layers of the blazer and cardigan provide warmth for an autumn night while maintaining a sophisticated silhouette suitable for a festive gathering. Her own preference for a specific occasion style is honored through refined textures like wool-blend and silk that elevate the look without crossing into overly formal territory."}
